calendar.matters:
NAME CHANGE CALENDAR
Off Calendar Jun-25-2019 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 514. Judge: Newton Lam. Clerk: K. Dougherty. Proceedings Not Reported.

Petitioner Tania Sonia Shul was present in pro per on behalf of the Minor, Methuselah Tlaloc Castellanos Shul, who was not present for this morning's proceedings.
Order Granting petitioner's request to change the minor's name without giving further notice to the other parent was filed June 24, 2019.
Proof of Publication in the file.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of the Minor to Tlaloc Shul Castellanos.

Decree Changing Name was submitted to and signed by the Court.
